initial: Explicit TIME_RANGE and legacy complete TIME_FIELD expressions supply program dates; combined range plus grain consumed fully; a field name alone cannot authorize model dates
components: RANGE and GRAIN are recomputed from current edit evidence after existing handle/authority/type checks. CLEAR/ANCHOR retain native rules, versions and dependencies.
comparison: Explicit baseline dates derive from current comparison mention; PREVIOUS_YEAR/PREVIOUS_PERIOD keep existing deterministic calendar arithmetic
clock: Existing business Asia/Shanghai clock, injected aware time; internal UTC instants; no history-derived now
literal_interval: Two aware ISO endpoints separated by 至 with explicit exclusive-end marker; ordered/nonempty required

bounded_grammar.counterexamples: Embedded negation, repeated edit cues, unsupported qualifiers, alternatives, non-aware/reversed intervals, conflicting grains remain rejected

limits: Unsupported date grammar fails closed; this does not claim every natural-language temporal form is recognized
Legacy TIME_FIELD compatibility retains the existing scoped time-field selection; semantic anchor-role/catalog selection quality is still a separate acceptance axis
No new fiscal calendar, watermark, system-default period, comparison rule inference or production route
